limits: Both source snapshots are non-atomic live-output prefixes, not terminal runs. Only complete states accepted in each captured .sta prefix are included.

The original half-step snapshot has 26 accepted states through 0.013 s. Its original partial log remains immutable; the separately pinned strict-prefix supplement is used only for completed summaries at those accepted times, with later state summaries excluded.
The folder name means these times precede the coarse run's reported bolt-hole contact onset; it does not assert zero active contact or qualify the half-step contact history.
The actual load follows the serialized 101-point RAMP_N table and 100 N reference-pattern scale; the 100 N value is not the net applied force at these times.
The work comparison uses the audited discrete accepted-increment projection and native external-work print. Native energy quantities are copied from CCX log summaries.

The observed differences establish neither time-step accuracy nor convergence, and do not identify a cause. They do not validate contact equilibrium, material response, quasi-static behavior, joint capacity, or mechanical acceptance.
